mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 7.5% over a 3-month period, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% over 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal robust economic activity across consumer and business sectors, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO increase, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly job growth (PAYEMS) consistently signals improving consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 700 thousand units, it signals weak consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 700, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a monetary tightening cycle coinciding with labor market weakness, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, strong industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust business activity and earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
